payload.title: Mermaid diagrams render on every standard site by default
payload.description: Fenced mermaid blocks render as diagrams on projected pages: self-hosted lazy loader plus library, source kept as a readable pre and verbatim in the Markdown twin, strict security level, accessible, theme tokens, no colour coding. Config: mermaid.enabled. Specs: features_backend/mermaid-diagrams.feature, scripts/test-mermaid-browser.ts. Docs: docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md.
